items.title: ZTS Q3 2026 deep dive: competitive pressures and margin headwinds weigh on outlook
items.summary: Animal health company Zoetis (NYSE:ZTS) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales fell by 1.3% year on year to $2.39 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $9.27 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.75 per share was 15.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
